comment: SPEC-024 Amendment 2026-11-01, point 1: the pinned WiX release and .NET SDK, with each nuget package's SHA-512 as nuget.org's catalog publishes it (packageHash, base64). `carried` marks a package whose binaries the setup or the MSI carries onto the endpoint; check-licences.mjs admits those by name. wixCommit is the commit the release tag v<wixRelease> names, which wixInformationalVersion abbreviates, and wixTree its tree: the release archives that tree as the source of the WiX files the setup carries (the Amendment 2026-11-14, point 3). A change to this file is a reviewed change.
